name: our-tool-belt
description: Portable MCP connections, skills and rules for APIs, data and browser-tested apps. Run python3 belt.py use to drop it into a project.

commands.description: Write this belt into the current project for Cursor, OpenCode, Claude Code or VS Code.
Validate the belt, report missing env vars, and check local AI if it is running.
Print every item in the belt with its one-line description.
Scaffold a skill or package and register it in belt.json.
Change one allowlisted belt.json field and validate.
Run one allowlisted task (validate, tests, export, pins).
Regenerate belt.index.json and the AGENTS.md belt map. CI runs index --check.

servers.description: Read-only GitHub repos and PRs over MCP. Use when inspecting code or PRs; needs GITHUB_MCP_TOKEN.
Library docs for the installed version. Use when writing against a dependency; needs CONTEXT7_API_KEY. Never send secrets or private source.
Headless isolated browser via MCP. Use to verify a UI flow; needs Node.js. Does not attach to your real browser profile.

personalServers.note: Outside-work connections. Details omitted here. Pass --include-personal to list or export them.

models.description: Optional OpenAI-compatible local model for agent clients. Not an MCP server; nothing in the belt requires it to be running.

presets.description: Default local runtime at http://localhost:11434/v1. Use after ollama pull of the preset model tag.
LM Studio OpenAI-compatible server on port 1234. Set the model name before exporting to OpenCode.
llama.cpp server on port 8080. Set the model name before use.
vLLM OpenAI-compatible server on port 8000. Set the model name before use.

packages.name: @playwright/mcp
packages.description: Pinned Playwright MCP server. Use via the playwright connection; bump this pin instead of editing server args.

packages.name: @modelcontextprotocol/inspector
packages.description: Pinned MCP Inspector CLI. Use with python3 scripts/mcp_smoke.py; not an exported connection.

packages.name: styling
packages.description: Design tokens as CSS variables and JSON. Use when theming belt-branded surfaces; not copied by client exports.

packages.name: zizmor
packages.description: Pinned GitHub Actions security linter. Use in CI via zizmor.yml; not an MCP server.

packages.name: actionlint-py
packages.description: Pinned actionlint (via actionlint-py). Use in CI via actionlint.yml to catch workflow syntax errors.

packages.name: shellcheck-py
packages.description: Pinned ShellCheck (via shellcheck-py). Use in CI via shellcheck.yml and actionlint -shellcheck; not an MCP server.

packages.name: gitleaks/gitleaks
packages.description: Pinned gitleaks CLI (github-release). Use in CI via gitleaks.yml to scan the repo for secrets; not an MCP server.

packages.name: ollmcp
packages.description: Pinned Ollama-native MCP terminal client. Use with the Claude Code export's .mcp.json; not a fifth adapter.

skills.description: Build a narrow API feature with a usable frontend path. Use for Python, Rails, Spring, React or Next.js feature requests, API contracts and micro-SaaS prototypes.
Reconcile exports and build repeatable data transformations. Use for Postgres or Snowflake extracts, CSV files, Pandas pipelines and Excel reconciliation reports.
Verify a web application user journey using browser evidence. Use for React or Next.js UI checks, regression reproduction and frontend-to-API troubleshooting.
Evaluate an MCP server or skill for inclusion in Tool Belt. Use for AI Vault candidates, marketplace submissions, connection changes and assistant compatibility reviews.

rules.description: Shared operating rules: small changes, secrets out of Git, honest verification. Always apply.
Clean code, tests, one PR per session, Conventional Commit titles, keep CI green. Follow on every code change.

adapters.description: Claude Code MCP config (.mcp.json). Also the file ollmcp --servers-json reads. Rules and skills need manual attach.
VS Code MCP config (.vscode/mcp.json). Rules and skills need manual attach; Copilot uses this file.
Cursor-native MCP, always-on rules and skills. Default target for `belt.py use` in an empty project.
OpenCode config with MCP plus a wired local-ai provider. Use when handing the belt to a local Ollama model.

scripts.description: One command entry point for the belt. Prefer this over calling scripts/ directly.
Build belt.index.json and the AGENTS.md map from belt.json. belt.py index wraps this.
Set one allowlisted belt.json value, then validate or roll back. belt.py set wraps this.
Copy managed adoption-kit files into an app repo. Use --adopt for a first install.
Shared load/save helpers for belt.json. Import from other scripts; do not run it.
Generate styling/tokens.css from tokens.json. --check confirms they match.
Look up newer stable npm/PyPI releases for pinned packages. Report-only unless --apply.
Run shellcheck on git-tracked shell scripts. CI uses the belt shellcheck pin; not part of client export.
Write one client export into a new directory. belt.py use wraps this and copies into a project.
Contact the local OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Only script that does; belt.py doctor wraps it.
Start one MCP server through the pinned Inspector and list (or call) a tool.
Scaffold a skill or package and register it. belt.py add wraps this.
Run one allowlisted belt task without a shell. belt.py run wraps this.
Validate belt.json without running tools or reading secrets. Use before export or commit.

workflows.description: Syntax-lint GitHub workflows with the actionlint-py pin from belt.json.
Reusable weekly sync of managed files into adopted app repos.
Weekly lookup of newer npm/PyPI pins; opens a draft PR if a stable release is newer.
Validate manifests, run tests, check tokens, export all four clients, and verify the generated index.
Scan the repository for leaked secrets with the gitleaks github-release pin from belt.json.
Reusable Conventional Commit title check for this repo and adopted apps.
Require a Conventional Commit pull request title.
Reusable release-please job for this repo and adopted apps.
release-please on push to main; merging its PR bumps versions and tags.
Manually run one allowlisted belt task and upload its log.
Lint tracked shell scripts with the shellcheck-py pin via scripts/check_shell.py.
Manually set one allowlisted belt.json value and open a draft PR.
Security-lint GitHub workflows with the zizmor pin from belt.json.

templates.description: App caller for the weekly managed-file sync.
App caller for PR-title and release-please reusable workflows.
Adoption marker (belt name + version). Validate with python3 scripts/validate.py APP_DIR.
App-repo agent instructions pointing at belt rules. Copied by belt_sync --adopt.
release-please manifest template; the app version starts at 0.0.0.
How to wire release-please, PR titles and optional tokens in an app repo.
Standalone PR-title caller template for app repos.
release-please config copied into an app repo (release-type, extra-files).
Standalone release-please caller template for app repos.

skipped.reason: files package; copy styling/ yourself. Client exports do not include it.
CI-only pin read by zizmor.yml; not an MCP server or export.
CI-only pin read by actionlint.yml; not an MCP server or export.
CI-only pin read by shellcheck.yml and actionlint -shellcheck; not an MCP server or export.
CI-only pin read by gitleaks.yml; not an MCP server or export.
Used by scripts/mcp_smoke.py; not declared as a connection.
Optional client. Load the claude-code export with --servers-json; not a fifth adapter.
Consumed through the playwright server args, not copied as its own export.
Outside-work connections. Omitted from exports and this index unless --include-personal.
Not an export adapter. Needs a hosted integration this belt does not generate.

secretRefs.name: CONTEXT7_API_KEY
secretRefs.description: Set in the client environment before using the matching MCP server.

secretRefs.name: LOCAL_AI_API_KEY
secretRefs.description: Optional local-runtime key; Ollama ignores it.

ollama launch claude in that project; attach INSTRUCTIONS.md and skills/.

load.then: Not an export adapter. HTTP header placeholders are not expanded; see docs/local-ai.md.
